purpose: All 210 validation images receive exactly the same generic query, as a supplementary check against dependence on native first-caption input. Same six bidirectional recall measures, identical split and policy.
inference: Whole-gallery paired intervals resample source-image contributions to recalls (including their five text queries), conditional on the observed gallery; no new training seeds. Detail intervals also resample intact source photos including both wordings/views. Secondary stochastic both-view accuracy averages four matched draws and also reports independent-draw sensitivity.
